name: One Question
thesis: The whole site is one question — what do you drive? — and everything after is the answer.

pages.index.html: The question and the living answer: particle car, parts that fit, how buying works, your people, sell CTA
pages.market.html: Marketplace for your car: fit, category, price and condition filters, sort, live re-sort on car change
pages.part.html: The coilover: turntable video, fit verdict for your car, came-off car, buyer protection, Buy now checkout sheet
pages.garage.html: Your garage: ARIA tabs of the cars you've answered with, particle preview, make primary, saved parts, add a car
pages.sell.html: Sell flow, one question at a time: what came off your car, price, review, listed

showpiece: Three.js GPU particle car (48k points per car) that re-draws itself nose-to-tail along curl-field paths as you type your car, loosens into a cloud for unknown cars, and flares on submit while the answer flies into the nav chip.
